verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a marketing claim that JumpCloud enforces SSO and MFA across all SAML and OIDC-based apps. That suggests SAML/OIDC apps can be connected, but nothing confirms custom apps outside the catalog can be configured. A community note says the SSO is "not that bad" but that the admin had to figure out integration largely alone, which hints that guidance is thin. Missing for 10: explicit custom/non-catalog SAML and OIDC app configuration, header-based app SSO, documented step-by-step walkthroughs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
